usedFor: SprintOps holds sprint tasks, and Microsoft Excel logs them with “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new task is created” in SprintOps, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each new task becomes a row, so planning numbers live in a spreadsheet too.

watchOut: “Add Row To Table” needs an existing Excel table, so create the table before the first task arrives.
